methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 8 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $8.3B - $126.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Scale AI, a private AI & Software company, is currently valued at $29B following $15.9B in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 8 private companies in the same sector and similar valuation tier, with 1 public comparable (Palantir, PLTR). The peer universe ranges from early-stage players like Reflection AI ($25B, Series A) through established pre-IPO operators such as Waymo ($126B).

Peer-median analysis, the primary applicable triangulation method, identifies a median valuation of $14.5B across the 8-company cohort. This method encompasses a wide range—from Applied Intuition at $15B (Series F) and Skild AI at $14B (Series C) at the tighter end, to Figure AI at $39B (Series C) and Waymo at $126B (Pre-IPO) at the upper bound. The peer set exhibits substantial dispersion, with valuations spanning $8.3B to $126B, reflecting heterogeneous maturity and market positioning within frontier AI.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $12.3B to $16.7B, centered on the $14.5B peer median. Scale AI's current $29B valuation sits materially above this derived range. Key uncertainties include the tight applicability of early-stage comparables (Reflection AI at Series A) and wide dispersion driven by Waymo's pre-IPO status, which may not reflect Scale AI's specific business model and growth trajectory.
